purpose: RB-15 visual-reference normalization manifest for compact renderer comparisons
scope: fixture-scale normalization; no corpus loops, timing, or competitor benchmarks

normalization_pipeline.name: channel_order_normalization
normalization_pipeline.description: Convert input from any supported channel order and explicit packed byte order to canonical RGBA, including raw buffers with explicit row stride

normalization_pipeline.name: alpha_semantics_normalization
normalization_pipeline.description: Normalize straight, premultiplied, or opaque alpha inputs to canonical straight-alpha RGBA
normalization_pipeline.premultiplied_detection: heuristic sampling remains advisory only; the pipeline mutates alpha only when explicitly requested by CLI or render-context metadata
normalization_pipeline.override: render context alpha_semantics or explicit --left-alpha-mode / --right-alpha-mode flags; legacy --left-premultiplied / --right-premultiplied map to premultiplied
normalization_pipeline.output: straight-alpha RGBA with opaque inputs forced to alpha=255

normalization_pipeline.name: exif_orientation
normalization_pipeline.description: Apply EXIF orientation tag to normalize rotation/flip metadata

normalization_pipeline.name: render_context_pixel_normalization
normalization_pipeline.description: Apply active render-context pixel normalization after channel and alpha normalization
normalization_pipeline.background_policy: explicit render-context RGBA backgrounds are composited into the canonical RGBA surface
normalization_pipeline.grayscale_policy: grayscale=true converts RGB channels to canonical luma while preserving alpha
normalization_pipeline.dimension_policy: declared width/height or dimensions are exact validation bounds after EXIF and render-context rotation, not resize hints

normalization_pipeline.name: canonical_rgba_surface
normalization_pipeline.description: Final unified 8-bit RGBA surface for comparison

normalization_pipeline.name: render_context_policy
normalization_pipeline.description: Normalize sidecar render metadata for later corpus adjudication without running a renderer, including deterministic structured font-environment identity
normalization_pipeline.font_environment_policy: strings are trimmed/lowercased; structured dict/list manifests are recursively canonicalized with sorted object keys, normalized path separators, and a SHA-256 fingerprint

normalization_pipeline.name: expected_difference_mask
normalization_pipeline.description: Grayscale mask where nonzero pixels are excluded from comparison
normalization_pipeline.format: any image format loadable as grayscale
normalization_pipeline.validation: dimensions must match input images exactly

normalization_pipeline.name: critical_region_classification
normalization_pipeline.description: Connected mismatch regions classified by severity tier and likely renderer-difference taxonomy

severity_tiers.critical: large region (>=16px), high edge weight (>=30.0), high fill ratio (>=0.6)
severity_tiers.significant: moderate size (>=16px) or moderate edge weight (>=15.0)
severity_tiers.minor: small region (>=4px) with low structural impact

legacy_compatibility.description: Legacy --left-bgra-raw / --right-bgra-raw flags map to channel_order=bgra + raw_mode

test_coverage.fixture_strategy: synthetic in-memory images via Pillow; no external files required
